highlights: Implemented support for a new ATen operator in PyTorchSim by defining custom lowerings and MLIR-based execution paths.

work.name: AIAC Lab, Hallym University
highlights: Conducted research on Edge AI inference performance modeling, predicting delay, power, energy, and EDP using regression-based approaches.
Built an experimental measurement pipeline on Jetson Orin Nano for collecting fine-grained runtime and power data.
